consequence.Ra_note: Ra = g beta dT d^3/(nu D). As coded beta -> beta/3 and D -> D/rho_sph[SI] (x lattice moment). If Ra is computed from the cascade D, Ra_eff/Ra = rho_sph/3 (about 2.6e3 for iron). If Ra is computed from a MEASURED kappa_eff (as the U14 design sketch does, 1-D bar decay), the conduction defect is absorbed into kappa_eff and the as-coded onset appears about 3x too high in dT, from buoyancy alone.
